Sourdough starter smells like nail polish?

crumbshot 2 days ago

My starter is ten days old and suddenly smells like acetone. It still bubbles. Is it ruined?

levain_lou 2 days ago

Not ruined. An acetone smell means the yeast is hungry. Feed it twice a day at a 1:1:1 ratio for a few days and the smell goes away.

crumbshot yesterday

Feeding twice a day fixed it. Thanks!
